entities.summary: The Strasbourg Mosque, also known as the Great Mosque of Strasbourg, is a large purpose-built mosque in the city of Strasbourg, France. It is located on the banks of the Ill river in the Heyritz area, south of the Grande Île. It was inaugurated in September 2012 and has a capacity of 1,200 worshipers.
